doubts: This page describes several separate Nevis Valley tracks, so kind is network, and each track is a way only where the text gives its start and end. The main way is the first track described, Nevis-Gibbston Track; the page does not say which is main. The packet has no road-end features, so the Nevis Road starts and the boundary ends have no refs. For River Face, Dark Elliots, Sunny Elliots and Scotchmans Creek the start is given only as 'from Nevis Road' in the time heading, and the text says the River Face track branches from the Nevis-Gibbston Track; River Face's start is therefore the junction, not a named place. Ryders Track's start is the sign on Nevis Road, and Scotchmans Creek starts from Nevis Road after following Ryders Track. Shape is one_way for each, from each track's 'one way' time and its end point.
